boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring St. Scholastica observances spanning service, music, campus ritual, alumni connection, and community hospitality.

cards.title: Community Day
cards.subtitle: Semester service across the Twin Ports
cards.notes: Join a listed service project or organize one with your club or team. The College pauses undergraduate classes so the community can volunteer.
cards.short_summary: A long-running, semesterly service day that moves the campus into Twin Ports projects.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Scholastica identifies Community Day as a tradition since 1999 and says its fall and spring service days involve students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: A year of community: St. Scholastica’s top 25 moments from 2025
cards.access_notes: Participation and project sign-up details vary by semester; consult the College’s current Community Day announcements.

cards.title: Homecoming Weekend
cards.subtitle: Saints reunions, athletics, and campus programs
cards.notes: Use the College’s current Homecoming schedule to pick a public event, then pair it with a game, reunion activity, or student performance.
cards.short_summary: An annual Saints gathering built around alumni connection and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The College described its 16th annual Homecoming as a cherished tradition bringing together alumni, students, parents, and the broader community.
cards.source_title: A year of community: St. Scholastica’s top 25 moments from 2025
cards.access_notes: Usually held in fall; confirm dates, registration needs, and event access through the College’s current Homecoming page.

cards.title: O Holy Night
cards.subtitle: Annual St. Scholastica Christmas concert
cards.notes: Watch for the December program and reserve through the College’s arts listings if required. Student choral, brass, and string musicians perform together.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale holiday concert that brings multiple St. Scholastica ensembles into one program.
cards.evidence_claim: The College calls O Holy Night its cherished annual Christmas tradition and reported that more than 100 student musicians performed in 2025.
cards.source_title: A return to tradition: O Holy Night, 13th annual Christmas concert
cards.access_notes: Presented annually in December; check the current Spotlight or College event listing for tickets and venue details.

cards.title: Lighting a Tradition
cards.subtitle: Tower Hall holiday lighting gathering
cards.notes: Attend Advent Vespers first if desired, then gather on the front steps of Tower Hall for the lighting. Confirm the current date before going.
cards.short_summary: A Tower Hall lighting ceremony that follows the College’s Advent Vespers observance.
cards.evidence_claim: The College lists Lighting a Tradition as an annual holiday-season ceremony on the front steps of Tower Hall following Advent Vespers.
cards.source_title: Celebrating community: Holiday events at the College
cards.access_notes: Annual December timing; verify the current service and ceremony schedule with Campus Ministry or College events.

cards.title: Advent Vespers
cards.subtitle: Annual chapel service with the Monastery
cards.notes: Check the holiday calendar for the service time and chapel details. The service is hosted with the Sisters of St. Scholastica Monastery and Campus Ministry.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Advent service rooted in the College’s Benedictine connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes Advent Vespers as an annual service celebrated by the Sisters of St. Scholastica Monastery and Campus Ministry.
cards.source_title: Celebrating community: Holiday events at the College
cards.access_notes: Annual December observance; review the current Campus Ministry or College holiday schedule before attending.

cards.title: Messiah Singalong
cards.subtitle: College-led community singalong
cards.notes: Bring a score if you have one, or ask at the door about borrowing or purchasing one. Follow the current event listing for the year’s format.
cards.short_summary: A decades-long College music gathering centered on Handel’s Messiah.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reported that its Messiah Singalong was in its 42nd annual year in 2024, with College ensembles helping lead participants.
cards.source_title: From Vespers to voices: Holiday events at the College
cards.access_notes: Typically a December event; the College stated participants could bring, purchase, or borrow scores. Confirm current arrangements first.

cards.entity_name: Twin Ports Region Thanksgiving Day Buffet
cards.title: Twin Ports Thanksgiving Day Buffet
cards.subtitle: College-hosted regional Thanksgiving gathering
cards.notes: If you plan to help, use the College’s Thanksgiving page when volunteer registration opens. If dining, check the annual serving and delivery instructions.
cards.short_summary: A College-hosted Thanksgiving service tradition extending hospitality beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College hosts the annual Twin Ports Region Thanksgiving Day Buffet and stated that the 2025 dinner was offered free of charge.
cards.source_title: St. Scholastica to host annual Twin Ports Regional Thanksgiving Day Buffet
cards.access_notes: Held on Thanksgiving Day at the DECC in the cited year; confirm current meal, volunteer, and delivery instructions through css.edu/thanksgiving.

cards.title: Veterans Day Event
cards.subtitle: Veterans Resource Center flag-raising observance
cards.notes: Start at the Somers Hall flagpole for the invocation and flag raising, then follow the program indoors for the recognition gathering.
cards.short_summary: An annual Veterans Resource Center observance joining ceremony, music, and campus recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says its Veterans Resource Center continues an annual Veterans Day event with an invocation, ROTC flag raising, and choir anthem.
cards.source_title: From veteran to advocate: Jon Whaley’s journey at St. Scholastica
cards.access_notes: Scheduled around Veterans Day; verify the current start time and indoor program details with the Veterans Resource Center.

cards.title: Give to CSS Day
cards.subtitle: The College’s annual Saints giving day
cards.notes: Follow the annual campaign online, choose a College fund if you wish to participate, or share the campaign with the Saints community.
cards.short_summary: A recurring day when the Saints community rallies around College funds and student opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The College calls Give to CSS Day its annual, single largest giving day and announced the 2026 observance for March 19.
cards.source_title: St. Scholastica announces March 19 as annual Give to CSS Day
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually, but the date and featured funds change; use the College’s current Give to CSS Day page for participation details.

cards.title: Rose Warner Reading Series
cards.subtitle: Annual guest-writer gathering and Dignitas Common Element
cards.notes: Check the Arts + Ideas calendar for the year’s guest and venue. Attend the evening reading, then use the event as a starting point for discussion.
cards.short_summary: A recurring literary event connecting St. Scholastica readers with visiting writers.
cards.evidence_claim: The College states that the Rose Warner Reading Series was developed as an annual event and serves as a Dignitas Common Element.
cards.access_notes: The cited College page describes the evening event as free and open to the public; confirm the current program date and venue.
